A1.justification: Both complete 21-page PDFs describe the same BizGen work. Text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–L support reliable comparison. The appendix pages match in both extracted text and rendering.

before.justification: v1 reports original infographic and slide generation experiments, ablations, and a 10-participant user study, with additional empirical results in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark results, user study, ablations, and supplementary generation experiments.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix D retain the same retrieval-augmented data engine, layout-guided cross-attention, hybrid training loss, and layout-conditional guidance. No algorithm or model component changes.

E1.justification: Infographics-650K, Slides-500K, and BizEval coverage remain unchanged, including ten-language generation and the appendix scenarios involving multiple styles and transparent layers.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains DALL·E3, SD3 Large, FLUX, and Glyph-SDXL-v2; Table 2 retains its original three comparators. Appendix Table 6 also retains the DataEngine comparison.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Table 7 retain identical training settings, resolutions, prompt/layout conditions, OCR and GPT-4o evaluation procedures, and user-study design.

E4.justification: The data-scale, attention-design, resolution, and artifact-removal analyses in Section 4.5 are unchanged. Appendix C's data-engine comparison and Appendix K's guidance-timing sensitivity analysis also match.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate reporting. Neither adds or changes repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Numerical and qualitative findings match throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 1's BizGen spelling precision for infographics with at least 20 layers remains 55.48%; Figure 4's user-study results are also unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation, loss, and guidance equations (1)–(8) are unchanged. No definitions, assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised in the appendices.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same article-level generation scope, data-engine and layout-control contributions, and comparative claims on BizEval.

C2.justification: Interpretations remain unchanged, including the advantages over direct assembly in Appendix C, difficulties with dense tiny text in Appendix H, and the guidance-timing tradeoff in Appendix K.

D1.justification: Hyperparameters, hardware, training time, implementation explanations, supplementary prompts, and the project link are unchanged. The added corresponding-author email supplies no new code or data access instructions.

R1.justification: Related-work positioning and all 44 bibliography entries remain unchanged. Updated citation back-reference pages and the Ideogram link's footnote formatting do not change the cited research.

P1.justification: v2 marks five authors as Microsoft research interns and adds a corresponding-author email. Body prose, terminology, section order, and appendix wording remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The added first-page footnote and minor formatting changes reflow the main text: the Introduction starts on page 2 instead of page 1, and the Conclusion continues onto page 9. Figures and tables retain their content and design; appendix layouts are identical.

improvement.justification: v2 adds useful author-role and correspondence information, but the methods, evidence, scientific explanations, and complete appendices remain unchanged. The limited administrative and layout edits do not meaningfully improve or diminish overall paper quality.
